title: Vedrai, carino
subtitle: Zerlina: aria from Don Giovanni, Act 2 (No. 18)

passages.label: Vedrai, carino, se sei buonino … ti voglio dar!
È naturale … non lo sa far · È un certo balsamo … se il vuoi provar
Saper vorresti dove mi sta? (to the fermata)
Sentilo battere, toccami quà! (to the fermata)
Sentilo battere, toccami quà (again) · the piano's close

licences.notes: Words as printed in the Schirmer vocal score (t'el, quà, and the added no in non lo sa far, no; the libretto has tel, qua and non lo sa far).

licences.source: G. Schirmer vocal score, New York 1900 (plate 15147, IMSLP #68957), pages 184–187, bars 1–104 of No. 18
licences.author: G. Schirmer, piano reduction as printed
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the sung line and the piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar and checked again by a fresh checker. The English singing translation and the stage directions are left out; Masetto is on stage but does not sing. Two corrections to the print: in bar 82 Zerlina's E is written as a dotted eighth, as in bars 78 and 80 (the print has no dot, which leaves the bar a sixteenth short), and in bar 4 the left hand gets a sixteenth rest to fill the bar. Playback tempo: Grazioso ♩ = 44 (an eighth note = 88), about 3:33, from the median (3:34) of five complete recordings (Fricsay 1958 3:14, Giulini 1959 3:14, Böhm 1977 4:11, Haitink 1984 3:42, Karajan 1985 3:34); the fermatas in bars 51–52 and 75 are held. Mozart gives the word Grazioso only.
